# `<sl-step>` — Step

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Steps are the individual stages of a [stepper](stepper.md).

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/step/step.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | — | `string` | `''` | A short line under the label, e.g. what the step collects. |
| `error` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the step as having a problem, e.g. a validation error in the part of the form it represents. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents the user from navigating to this step. |

## Properties without an attribute

These can only be set from JavaScript: `element.prop = value`, `[prop]="value"` in Angular, `.prop=${value}` in Lit. Writing them as HTML attributes does nothing.

| Property | Type | Notes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `number` |  | The step's zero-based position. The stepper keeps this in sync — don't set it yourself. |
| `state` | `'complete' \| 'current' \| 'upcoming'` |  | Where the step sits relative to the stepper's current step. The stepper keeps this in sync. |
| `last` | `boolean` |  | Whether this is the stepper's last step, which has no connector. The stepper keeps this in sync. |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` |  | The stepper's orientation. The stepper keeps this in sync. |
| `interactive` | `boolean` |  | Whether the user can navigate to this step by clicking it. The stepper keeps this in sync. |
| `completeLabel` | `string` |  | Text announced after the label of a completed step. The stepper keeps this in sync. |
| `errorLabel` | `string` |  | Text announced after the label of a step with an error. The stepper keeps this in sync. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The step's label. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `control` | The clickable area holding the indicator and text. A `<button>` when the step can be navigated to, otherwise a `<div>`. |
| `indicator` | The circle showing the step number, a check mark or an error mark. |
| `label` | The container that wraps the label. |
| `description` | The description under the label. |
| `connector` | The line leading to the next step. |

## Documentation and examples

Steps go in a [stepper](stepper.md), which works out whether each one is complete, current or upcoming from
its `current` index. Put the label in the default slot and an optional one-line `description` under it.

```html
<sl-stepper current="1">
  <sl-step description="Protocol, subject, organizations">General information</sl-step>
  <sl-step description="Letters, drawings, annexes">Attachments</sl-step>
  <sl-step disabled description="Not available for incoming">Relations</sl-step>
</sl-stepper>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/step/step.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/stepper/stepper.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-step-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-stepper current="1">
      <sl-step description="Protocol, subject, organizations">General information</sl-step>
      <sl-step description="Letters, drawings, annexes">Attachments</sl-step>
      <sl-step disabled description="Not available for incoming">Relations</sl-step>
    </sl-stepper>
  `
})
export class StepExampleComponent {}
```
